title: Frank P NDE 4272
content: I was on the table in the emergency room and I asked the doctors if they were giving me anesthesia. They told me no, but to try to stay awake. I suddenly fell back and was fully surrounded by an energy of a white light. I have NEVER seen this color white here on Earth. It did not hurt my eyes to see it. I felt relaxed, with no thoughts of my family or my past. I somehow knew I was in the place I have heard others talk about. I do not know how I knew this. I then heard a male voice ask me 'Frank, do you want to go with me or go back?' Without hesitation, I said 'go back'. I immediately felt the shock of the paddles come in on my right chest and cross to the left. With this, I popped up into a sitting position. The doctor asked if I was ok. I said 'yes'. I then do not remember anything else until 24 hours' later, when I awoke in the ICU. It took 2 days to remove the ventilator. As soon as I could speak, I told my wife and daughter what had happened. I was afraid to sleep after this. I felt as though I would go again and not return. I spoke with a priest in the hospital and my wife about it. I soon realized there was no reason to worry. I realized it did not hurt to die, and when we do we go to a wonderful place that I was privileged to see.
